import { Component } from '@angular/core'; @Component({ selector: 'app-main', standalone: true, templateUrl: './main.component.html', styleUrls: ['./main.component.css'], }) export class MainComponent {}
Remote MFE · main-container · :4201

Main Container

This is the Main Container microfrontend. It is loaded dynamically by the Shell App via Webpack Module Federation and rendered at the top of the content area.

Module Federation

Loaded via loadRemoteModule at runtime from port 4201.

Independently Deployable

This app can be built, tested, and deployed without touching other MFEs.

Shared Libraries

Angular core packages are shared as singletons with the shell and siblings.
